entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit! My name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get your full name please?

Thank you, Alex. I see your order here. It looks like it was delivered about 27 days ago. That's unfortunately outside the 10 days for our return policy, so it's absolutely no problem to get this sent back.
Oh, great! That was easy. I was a little worried I might have missed the window.
Not at all! I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. It should be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you'll be all set.

And one more thing, Alex. I see you're a VIP member with us. As a small thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $15 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase. I really appreciate your business.
Wow, I wasn't expecting that. Thank you, Judy! That's really great service.
You are very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a huge help.
Glad to hear it! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
